title: Model SBI as a multi-issuer distribution network; separate stablecoin availability from XRPL and XRP usage

decisions.rule: Record Circle SBI Japan KK / SBI Circle Holdings Co., Ltd. as a 50/50 USDC-focused JV. Record the USD50M Circle IPO investment separately from the JV and separately from XRP flows.
SBI VC Trade's USDC and RLUSD offerings establish multi-issuer distribution. Do not assume the two products share custody, networks, redemption paths or liquidity.

Record direct Circle-Ripple cooperation on USDC/XRPL separately from Ripple's RLUSD competition. Ripple's XRP bridge description is a product claim until actual DEX/auto-bridge execution volumes are measured.
SBI VC Trade USDC inbound deposits are documented as Ethereum-only. Do not infer an XRPL route from native USDC availability on XRPL or from SBI's separate RLUSD listing.
SBI's USD50M Circle IPO investment and dated approximately 9% Ripple stake are separate historical equity exposures. Do not infer current ownership, token holdings or price-support behavior.
Keep SBIC East Japan separate from SBI Holdings, SBI VC Trade, Circle SBI Japan KK and SBI Ripple Asia. Acronym similarity is not corporate affiliation.

feature_admission: NONE. SBI JV, equity investments, USDC/RLUSD listings and network routes are corporate/operational context. No SBI-linked XRPL settlement or XRP bridge-volume feature is admitted without transaction-level evidence.
